about: A command-line bookmark manager that keeps your bookmarks in a small local database.

prs.title: Bookmark titles with brackets or & export cleanly
prs.broken: Exporting bookmarks to the browser format wrote titles, tags and notes as they were. A title with angle brackets, like those on web reference pages, broke the file, and importing it back lost the title.
prs.changed: Titles, tags and notes are now written safely in the exported file, as the other export format already did.
prs.matters: Bookmarks moved to a browser or back keep their full titles.

prs.title: Bookmark feeds with & in a title stay readable
prs.broken: Exporting bookmarks as an RSS or Atom feed wrote titles as they were. One title like "Q&A" or "AT&T" broke the whole file, so feed readers and buku itself rejected it.
prs.changed: Titles are now written safely, the same way links, tags and notes already were.
prs.matters: Exported feeds open in feed readers and import back into buku.

prs.title: Bookmark notes survive an XBEL import
prs.broken: Importing an XBEL bookmark file dropped every bookmark's notes, even files that buku had exported itself.
prs.changed: The import now looks for the notes inside each bookmark, where the format puts them.
prs.matters: Moving bookmarks between buku and other apps keeps the notes people wrote.
